summary: Destiny Tech100 Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $1,000,000,000 in common stock under a Sales Agreement with Jefferies LLC. The offering is a routine capital raise through continuous equity sales at prevailing market prices; no fixed price per share, premium, or acquisition terms are involved. Shares trade on NYSE under DXYZ; the last reported price on May 21, 2026 was $61.66 per share, versus net asset value per share of $24.56 as of March 31, 2026. Jefferies receives a 3.0% commission. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation. No event-driven event such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring is present.
